keys.label: Fill in

note.start: Tap a cell, then a digit or black.
note.redRows: The red rows aren't right yet.

rules.title: How it works
rules.digits: Every row and every column holds each digit from 1 to {{k}} exactly once.
rules.blacks_one: Every row and every column has exactly one black cell.
rules.blacks_other: Every row and every column has exactly {{count}} black cells.
rules.sums: The numbers along the edge are the sums of the groups of digits that touch, in order. A black cell splits two groups.
rules.check: All filled in? Tap Check. You see for each row whether it is right; right rows stay as they are. You may check {{max}} times.
rules.note: Digit? is a note: a digit goes here, you don't know which yet.
rules.noClock: There is no clock. You can simply carry on later today.

done.solution: The solution is above; red is what you had differently.
